problem.title: Make Lexicographically Smallest Array By Swapping Elements

approaches.title: Sort values and connect indices with DSU
approaches.summary: Sort value-index pairs and union adjacent values whose difference is within the limit. Group indices by DSU component, then assign each component’s sorted values to its indices in ascending order.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduced a DSU-based solution that identifies swappable components from adjacent sorted values and redistributes each component’s values.

approaches.title: Sort and process contiguous value groups
approaches.summary: Sort indices by their values and split them into contiguous groups where adjacent sorted values differ by at most the limit. Sort each group’s original indices and place the group’s values into those positions in ascending order.

revisions.commitComment: no need for dsu, sorting & chunking gives us groups
